items: 【7-Piece Dining Chair Set】This patio dining set contains 1 extended dining table and 6 ergonomic dining chairs. This modern outdoor dining table set features aesthetic appeal that seamlessly blends with various outdoor settings, adding charm and elegance to your patio or garden, which is perfect for your family events.

【Spacious Dining Table with Umbrella hole】The patio dining table is designed with an umbrella hole, allowing you to add shade during sunny days. The outdoor table measures 66.9"D*32.3"W*29.1"H, which can holds up to 220LBS, providing enough room to accommodate meals, drinks, and table decor.

【Comfortable Dining Chairs】This patio dining chair is perfect for your family gathering. Featuring its armrest and slatted seat, adding extra comfort to the chairs. Each chair measures 23.4"D*23.6"W*33.6"H, its weight capacity is up to 330LBS.

【Easy Installation】This outdoor dining table set is packaged in 7 different packages and may arrive on different days. Partial installation required. Each conversation patio furniture set includes detailed instructions and all the necessary hardware, enabling you to set up your dining area quickly and hassle-free. Instructional video is provided on our website. (ATTN: Do Not Screw The Screws Tightly Before Finishing).

【All Weather Use】SERWALL patio dining sets are built to withstand the elements and provide long-lasting performance. The sturdy frames and high-density polyethylene materials ensure durability and reliability, allowing you to enjoy outdoor dining for years to come.

【Low Maintenance】HDPE dining table sets required low maintenance. Unlike the Steel dining sets may require rust prevention, SERWALL patio dining table and chairs are easy to clean with just soap and water, requiring minimal effort to keep them looking fresh.
【Customized Combinations】Whether hosting guests or dining with family, this versatile set adapts to your needs. Choose individual chairs for a custom setup.

【Customer Service】Your satisfaction is our top priority. We are committed to providing excellent customer service and support. Should you have any questions or concerns, our dedicated customer service team is ready to assist you .

【Indoor & Outdoor Use】Different from the normal HDPE dining sets, our patio dining table and chairs are designed with wood texture. The classic appearance makes these dining table sets more usable for indoor or outdoor.

【Family-Friendly】HDPE patio dining table sets are family-friendly, providing a comfortable and safe space for outdoor meals and gatherings. The rounded edges are safer than sharp steel frames, ideal for families with children.
